conflict|Strefa Gazy / Izrael.description: Trump’s son-in-law and senior negotiator paints Russian invasion of Ukraine as a misunderstanding to be resolvedIn the space of a 70-minute interview, Jared Kushner – Donald Trump’s son-in-law and a prominent US negotiator in Russia, Gaza and Iran – probably did more to reveal why the world is mired in entrenched conflicts than a thousand geopolitical tomes or seminars.During the conversation this week with Mathias Döpfner, the chief executive of the Axel Springer media publisher, Kushner gave a rare insight into his diplomatic technique, offering a string of homilies that veered close to banalities: “You have nothing until you have something”, “diplomacy is like untying knots on a fishing line for his son”, and “you play the ball from where it lands”.
